description: An `<onTransition>` inside a state-child carries neither `to=` nor `from=`. Per §51.0.H the element must name an edge, so E-ONTRANSITION-NO-TARGET fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §51.0.H — `<onTransition>` runs an effect on a specific EDGE, selected by `from=` and/or `to=`. With neither attribute the element selects no edge, so its body could never be attributed to a transition; the compiler cannot pick a default without inventing an edge the author did not declare.
